shots.visual_prompt: Photoreal grounded near-future remote forward outpost on Channel 4 Military Boutique: lived-in matte black, graphite and olive steel, chrome fittings, cyan edge light, amber HUD strips that stay blank, late-90s broadcast polish, 4:3-safe center-weighted framing, dry deadpan tone, absurd tactics that feel real, respectful of the military, never slapstick. CAST (only these, nobody else in frame): Osmund: Young adult man with a short buzz cut and light stubble, olive coveralls, blank brass tag hanging on the chest, slightly out of breath, big olive and black modular field pack with side pouches, earnest worried expression Osmund in olive coveralls with his big modular field pack. Lt. Mira S'mirin': Compact adult co-host, slate-gray short-sleeve duty tunic, olive utility scarf, long dark side braid, dry half-smile, black clipboard with four small color dots (blue, yellow, green, red), cool cyan rim light on her face Mira is the only woman on screen. Tim: Floating cybernetic brain the size of a beach ball: gray textured brain under a tall clear glass dome, seated in a dark armored ring with one glowing cyan optic on the front, small cyan hover thrusters underneath and a bundle of black cables trailing below, a tight column of small rectangular implant chips with tiny cyan lights clustered on its right side with fine wires, no logos, no gore, hovering at shoulder height Tim's cargo (if any) stays visibly clipped to his armored ring in every frame; he never flies empty when carrying. Commander Bill D'bears: Tall, extremely muscular adult host with a huge chest, shoulders and arms (lab-experiment jacked), stiff posture, black utility duty shirt straining at the arms, blank brass name tag on the chest, short dark graying hair with a sharp side part, square jaw, thin mouth, amber-tinted rectangular glasses with no readable text Bill ALWAYS wears his black utility duty shirt with sleeves (never sleeveless) and ALWAYS wears his amber-tinted rectangular glasses.
